description: This file defines a repository layer for database interactions related to Users and Tasks, using SQLAlchemy ORM. It encapsulates CRUD operations, error handling, and data validation for user and task models.

classes.name: RepositoryError
classes.description: Base exception class for repository-related errors.

classes.name: DuplicateEmailError
classes.description: Exception raised when attempting to create a user with an existing email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations related to User persistence, including user creation, retrieval, and authentication.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations related to Task persistence, including creation, listing, retrieval, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: User create_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password, handling duplicate emails.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(self, db: Session, *, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email address.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns the user if authentication succeeds.

methods.name: Task create_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all tasks for a specific user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Optional[Task] get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task by its ID, ensuring it belongs to the specified user.

methods.name: Optional[Task] update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, is_completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates task fields with validation, ensuring only the owner can modify.

methods.name: bool delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task if it belongs to the specified user.
